claim: Pre-registered SDT study of 3 LLMs over 168,000 trials finds temperature increases sensitivity (AUC) and shifts criterion simultaneously, so the temperature-as-criterion analogy breaks.
stance_target: F: SDT framing of LLM confidence is occupied for factual QA
scope_conditions: Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Llama-3-8B-Base, Q5_K_M; factual discrimination
quoted_support: Our results confirm the breakdown with temperature simultaneously increasing sensitivity (AUC) and shifting criterion.

breadth.confidence_families: normalized log-probability as evidence variable (Sec 3); SDT parametric fit
breadth.base_vs_instruct: yes: Llama-3-8B base vs instruct (z-ROC slope 0.77-0.87 vs 0.52-0.63, Abstract)
breadth.benchmarks: factual knowledge domains (168,000 trials); no code
breadth.calibration_metrics: AUC/d_a, z-ROC slope, criterion; contrasts with ECE (Abstract)
